title: Jason Buck - Designing the Cockroach Portfolio (S6E1)

reader_summary.headline: You were waiting for that intro, weren't you, buddy?
reader_summary.overview: You were waiting for that intro, weren't you, buddy? I'm Corey Hofstein and this is flirting with models, the podcast that pulls back the curtain to discover the human factor behind the quantitative strategy. Due to industry regulations, he will not discuss any of newfound researches funds on this podcast.

key_points.text: Jason Buck is the co-founder and CIO of Mutiny Funds and maybe one of the most interesting people I know.
key_points.evidence_quote: Jason Buck is the co-founder and CIO of Mutiny Funds and maybe one of the most interesting people I know.

key_points.text: Jason made and subsequently lost a small fortune in commercial real estate in the 2008 crash.
key_points.evidence_quote: Jason made and subsequently lost a small fortune in commercial real estate in the 2008 crash.

key_points.text: This ego-destroying event, as he puts it, was the catalyst for him to completely rethink the idea of resiliency, both in business and investments.
key_points.evidence_quote: This ego-destroying event, as he puts it, was the catalyst for him to completely rethink the idea of resiliency, both in business and investments.

key_points.text: Jason spent the better part of the 2010's developing the cockroach portfolio, a modern take on Harry Brown's permanent portfolio, a quarter stocks.
key_points.evidence_quote: Jason spent the better part of the 2010's developing the cockroach portfolio, a modern take on Harry Brown's permanent portfolio, a quarter stocks, a quarter bonds, a quarter quarter CTA, and a quarter long volatility.
